title: Magic Origins Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: A young man who, with his irregulars, worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros; a spear thrown by his hand felled his friends.

entities.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
entities.description: A band led by Kytheon that worked outside the law to bring justice to Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city whose streets Kytheon and his irregulars sought to bring justice to.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, known for the wingmare mount.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and telepath from Vryn to whom people's thoughts simply come.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose labs experience energy surges seen as opportunities for experimentation.

entities.name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
entities.description: A demanding demon master who has great things in mind for Liliana.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer whom Kothophed claims as his servant.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker and pyromancer whose gift set her apart; she discovered her nature in the moment before her execution.

entities.name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
entities.description: An elf leader who vows not to let eyeblights poison her land's beauty.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker and elf of Zendikar struck by the evil inside the mountain.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose chosen ones make the Sword of the Animist glow.

entities.name: Sword of the Animist
entities.description: A blade that glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

events.summary: Kytheon and his irregulars work outside the law to bring justice to Akros.
events.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

events.summary: A spear thrown by Kytheon fells his own friends.
events.quote: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

events.summary: Kothophed declares he will be Liliana's most demanding master.
events.quote: I will be your most demanding master, Liliana.

events.summary: In the moment before her execution, Chandra realizes what it means to be a pyromancer.
events.quote: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

events.summary: The evil inside the mountain strikes Nissa with a shock wave of madness.
events.quote: The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.

relations.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law

relations.note: Kothophed claims to be Liliana's master
relations.quote: I will be your most demanding master, Liliana.
The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.
